description: Week 6 chi-square tests were run against the 3-level appointment_outcome instead of a binary no-show outcome, deflating every Cramér’s V by a factor of sqrt(2) and testing the wrong hypothesis
impact: All five published effect sizes understated; one feature recommendation to Data Science invalid
resolution: All tests re-run on the decided-appointment base with binary outcome; v2 artefact issued

description: appointment_type was reported to Data Science as "Exclude — not statistically significant" on the basis of the invalid test
impact: Data Science may have excluded a feature for a stated reason that is false; if they cited it in their Week 6 write-up, that text needs correcting too
resolution: Reclassified to "Optional / low priority — real but negligible"; corrected artefact and change note sent to Data Science
status: Resolved on Analytics side — awaiting Data Science confirmation that their Week 6 model notes are updated

description: Dashboard panel titles hard-coded statistics as literal strings, so they did not update when the underlying tests changed
impact: Dashboard displayed statistics that were wrong the moment the tests were corrected
resolution: All annotations now interpolated from the live results object at render time

description: Dashboard showed no sample sizes or confidence intervals, and one panel charted a non-significant pattern as ascending bars
impact: Clinic decision-makers could over-read small-sample and non-significant differences as real
resolution: Wilson 95% intervals, n labels, reference line and explicit negative-verdict labelling added

description: Sunday appointment records — clinic operating hours not confirmed against the Knowledge Base (737 Sunday appointments in the data)
impact: If Sundays are not genuine clinic days, those rows may be synthetic artefacts affecting day-of-week analysis
resolution: Not attempted in Week 7 — deliberately out of scope, as day-of-week is not a significant predictor (p=0.38)

description: Reminder × prior-history interaction statistically unconfirmed; may be underpowered
impact: A plausible targeting rule cannot be justified from this dataset
resolution: Re-tested in Week 7 on corrected base — p moved 0.143 → 0.200, further from significance
status: Closed — not supported; do not pursue without new data

description: All findings remain observational; no causal test (e.g. randomised reminder pilot) has been run
impact: Recommendations cannot promise intervention outcomes, only associations
resolution: Proposed as a Week 8 discussion item — design a reminder A/B pilot for the clinic
